title: fix(components): page:header reads the spec's variant 'danger' as destructive (objectui#12764)
body:
Fixes #12764
Clause-②: no

The record header reads the spec's `variant: 'danger'` as destructive. Clause-② stays no: no prop, export or type member changes. The header reads its actions untyped, so no type union was widened, and an existing spec value now renders the way the spec defines it.

## What changed
- `page:header` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`) has ONE predicate, `isDestructiveAction` (`variant === 'danger' || name === 'sys_delete'`). It decides the overflow menu's destructive band, its separator, the red row, the inline style and the primary pick. Before this, the menu carried its own copy of the test.
- A danger action is never the filled primary. The primary is the first non-destructive row action, or the one declaring `variant: 'primary'` (objectui#12617's rule otherwise unchanged).
- Shown inline, a danger action uses the existing Shadcn `destructive` button (no new variant). Folded, it is a red row below the separator.
- `variant: 'destructive'` is no longer read. It is not a spec value (the enum is primary, secondary, danger, ghost, link: "danger = destructive"). The only header producer of it is the host's `sys_delete`, which is matched by name, so the Delete row is unchanged.
- The registry description of `maxVisible` and `content/docs/guide/slotted-pages.md` state the rule.

## Tests
New `page-header-danger-12764.test.tsx` (4 tests, the last a CONTROL for `sys_delete` and non-destructive actions). Each new behaviour was proven red by ablation: predicate back to `destructive` gave 3 failed; primary candidates unfiltered gave 2 failed; inline variant back to default/outline gave 2 failed. The control passed in every leg, and every leg was restored to HEAD blob 5af5a743. The family run on head 275db44 (code unchanged at 92659d8) gave 26 files and 812 tests passed. Type-check, changeset presence and claims, line citations, test-path-roots, spec-symbols and eslint were all clean.

## Live reading
Published `@objectstack/*@18.0.0-next.2` showcase, booted with `e2e/live/ci/start-backend.sh`. No showcase header action declares `danger`, so `showcase_submit_signoff` (invoice `record_header`) was given `variant: 'danger'` in the throwaway copy only. On INV-1004, before the fix: Submit for Sign-off was the filled primary and Edit was outline. After: Edit is the primary and Submit for Sign-off is the red destructive button. Screenshots are on branch `claude/issue-12764-evidence` under `evidence/12764/`.

## Acceptance notes
- RecordDetailView's host `sys_delete` and plugin-detail DetailView's `systemActions` (the action:bar surface) still write `variant: 'destructive'`. page:header now matches the Delete by name only. Not changed here: it is outside this card's surface.
- Host applications outside objectui that might inject a non-`sys_delete` header action with `variant: 'destructive'` were not measured.
